title: A worker whose gate the class rule makes blocking goes on with the recommendation and the landing waits for the operator's answer
goal: When gate add makes a worker's open choice blocking by its class (push, agents-rule) and the worker's recommendation is implementable, the worker finishes the work on the recommendation and land refuses until the operator answers, instead of the worker stopping (SP-dqkf3i42: workers stopped or recorded blocking gates on seven tasks, TK-uwu2lgvo twice, TK-g4c5kxsc, TK-7k2p3vif, TK-mialzcmq, TK-d556hzob, TK-mzssxnf6, TK-3zfpmq4u, TK-g67asvm5, three of them needing a resumed session only to carry out a plan the orchestrator then approved unchanged); agents/worker.md rule 6, the dispatch brief's fixed rule in bl_dispatch.py and kb/_self/backlog.md each say that a gate gate add prints as `made blocking` is committed open, the worker goes on with its recommendation and reports the gate, and that the class names who answers, never that work stops; the class rule stays fail-closed, so the push words (remote, origin, mirror, release, github, gitlab) still class a gate push, in a content gate too; the same rules name an implementation choice and a narrowing of the rows a goal names among the choices a worker records as provisional gates before it reports

run:
import pathlib, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_dispatch
brief = [r for r in bl_dispatch.worker_rules(pathlib.Path('.'), 'TK-aaaaaaaa', 'work/TK-aaaaaaaa') if 'made blocking' in r]
role = [l for l in pathlib.Path('agents/worker.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if 'made blocking' in l]
docs = [l for l in pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if 'made blocking' in l]
texts = brief + role + docs
ok = len(brief) == 1 and len(role) == 1 and docs and all(re.search(r'go(?:es)? on with (?:its|the|your) recommendation', t) for t in texts) \
    and not any(re.search(r'\bstop(?:s|ped)?\b', t) for t in brief + role)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as a, bl_base as b
words = ['Which release note wording?', 'Is the gitlab remote the target?', 'Does origin hold it?', 'Is the mirror updated?']
cls = [a.class_reasons({'touches': ['kb/public/x.md']}, {'id': 'g1', 'question': q, 'options': ['x', 'y']})[0] for q in words]
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(t)], check=True)
(t / 'kb/_self/backlog').mkdir(parents=True)
gate = {'id': 'g1', 'kind': 'blocking', 'question': 'q', 'options': ['x', 'y'], 'recommendation': 'x', 'class': 'push'}
b.Backlog(t).save({'id': 'ST-aaaaaaaa', 'kind': 'story', 'title': 't', 'status': 'todo', 'goal': 'g', 'gates': [gate]})
w = b.waits(b.Backlog(t), 'ST-aaaaaaaa', any_sprint=True)
sys.exit(0 if cls == ['push'] * 4 and any('gate ST-aaaaaaaa/g1' in x for x in w) else 1)

import pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_dispatch
rules = ' '.join(bl_dispatch.worker_rules(pathlib.Path('.'), 'TK-aaaaaaaa', 'work/TK-aaaaaaaa'))
role = pathlib.Path('agents/worker.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
doc = pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
ok = all('implementation choice' in t for t in (rules, role, doc)) and all('narrowing' in t for t in (rules, role))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: SP-ciqk6gt6 close: five gates were made blocking by the class rule after the work (TK-p7ajxp72 g2, TK-7nnd2bdm g1, TK-cagohpbu g2, TK-j5rcgylo g1, BG-rqxspwtb g3); each worker stopped and the orchestrator answered each with its recommendation. Recurred at SP-x5gjv4r7 (ST-xuhig3u6 g4 to g6, ST-ylje2dxh g3, ST-ifljijni g3; ST-ifljijni stopped before its docs) and SP-7n3d4jte (ST-b27c527d recorded four design gates, stopped before any code, a resumed session of 107 turns). Merged at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: BG-rwx7oh5s (a question naming a remote ref is class push; the push words fail closed, backlog.md), ST-6vtjmoyr (brief text on kinds of choice; 'implementation choice' absent from backlog.md), ST-gvf6yca7 (SP-ilje65fa, SP-tm4wlsve, SP-sbdy4hsx: github, mirror, origin/main words), ST-jar3qpfu (release, gitlab in a content gate), ST-fmjx3psu (BG-fl4sg2py: a worker narrowed the rows its goal names so a fixture test passed and called it no new choice; resumed to record g2 at SP-j2jn5ue4). Landing already waits: cmd_done refuses an open blocking gate (waits), so bl_land.py and bl_authority.py stay out of touches; check 1 guards that and the fail-closed class, and passes before the work. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 18 of 19, "Gates and filing: a misclassified gate does not stop a worker, and a refused repro is refused when filed"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. Premise run 2026-10-12: agents/worker.md:22 and the dispatch brief's fixed rule still say commit it and stop for a gate gate add prints as made blocking (check 0 fails on it); the landing already waits (check 1 passes before the work).
